title: 2017 Suicides Ordeal
text:
In the year 2017, IIT Kharagpur saw 5 student suicides. This is the highest number of suicides IIT Kharagpur witnessed in a single calendar year.

 Open House with the Director in Oct 2017 

Open House Video

This was the email sent by VP Mayank Srivastava right after the open house: http://archive.today/wV4Ol 

 Coverage in Indian Media 

The coverage of these suicides was limited to local and state-wide media organizations. There were no debates or editorial pieces written at any of the major publications in India about this unfortunate series of happenings. Several local edition articles reported the news on a timely manner though.
